summary: This Form 8-K was filed by Carvana Receivables Depositor LLC and Carvana Auto Receivables Trust 2026-P3 to report the closing of an asset-backed securities issuance. On August 25, 2026, the trust issued multiple classes of asset-backed notes secured by auto loan receivables purchased from Carvana, LLC. The filing includes standard transaction agreements such as the Receivables Purchase Agreement, Transfer Agreement, Contribution Agreement, and Trust Agreement. This is a routine securitization transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. There are no deal terms relevant to special-situations analysis; the filing solely documents the closing of a debt issuance. Watch for standard ABS performance metrics, but no risk-arb angle applies.
